Is an expired medicine sitting on your pharmacy shelf right now?

A survey of 100 pharmacists in Delhi, published in the Indian Journal of Pharmacology in 2016, found only 53% agreed there was a system to remove expired medicines from stock. Without one, expiry is found by hand, often too late, and the money paid for that batch is gone.

List every batch expiring in the next 90 days, flag expired stock still on the shelf, and always use the batch that expires first.

Source: Indian Journal of Pharmacology (2016), survey of doctors, nurses and pharmacists in Delhi.
